title: Pure Slifer the Sky Dragon
summary: Yugi Muto's Slifer the Sky Dragon strategy focuses on fielding the Executive Producer of the Sky with a 6-card hand (giving Slifer 6000 ATK / 6000 DEF!) while its mandatory floodgate effect ('If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your opponent's field in Attack Position: That monster(s) loses 2000 ATK, then if its ATK has been reduced to 0 as a result, destroy it') automatically vaporizes opposing combo starters and Link-climbers before they can be used! Discard Slifer for Joker's Straight (which puts Queen's Knight, King's Knight, and Jack's Knight on the board from 1 card and recycles all 3 cards in the End Phase to keep your hand full for Slifer!) or send Slifer to the GY with Foolish Burial, then flip the un-negatable Normal Trap The Revived Sky God during your opponent's turn to Special Summon Slifer from your GY AND make both players draw until they have 6 cards in hand—instantly creating a 6000 ATK Slifer backed by the Spell-Speed-4 board-wipe/draw spell Thunderforce Attack!

allow.Joker's Straight: Yugi's signature Poker Knight Spell: discards 1 card (if you discard Slifer the Sky Dragon, it sets up The Revived Sky God immediately!) to Special Summon Queen's Knight from your Deck, search King's Knight, and immediately Normal Summon King's Knight (which pulls Jack's Knight from your Deck)—assembling 3 Tributes for Slifer from 1 card, and then returning a LIGHT Warrior from GY during the End Phase to add itself back to your hand (+1000 ATK for Slifer!)!
allow.Joker's Knight: Level 5 LIGHT Warrior that sends Queen's, King's, or Jack's Knight from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself, and returns a LIGHT Warrior from your GY to the Deck during EVERY End Phase to add itself back to your hand—giving Slifer +1000 ATK every End Phase!
allow.Imperial Bower: Level 4 LIGHT Warrior that tributes itself to summon or search 2 of Queen's Knight, King's Knight, and Jack's Knight from your Deck.
allow.King's Knight: Summons Jack's Knight from your Deck when Normal Summoned while you control Queen's Knight.
allow.Queen's Knight: Summoned from Deck by Joker's Straight and Imperial Bower.
allow.Jack's Knight: Summoned from Deck by King's Knight.
allow.Trap Trick: Normal Trap that banishes 1 'The Revived Sky God' from your Deck to Set a second copy of 'The Revived Sky God' directly to your field that can be activated that very same turn!
allow.Monster Reborn: Limited to 1 in TCG: explicitly supported by The Revived Sky God's GY effect, which banishes itself from your GY to add Monster Reborn from your Deck or GY to your hand or place it on top of your Deck!
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Slifer the Sky Dragon directly from your Deck to the GY so The Revived Sky God is immediately live on Turn 1!

main: Slifer the Sky Dragon

Signature Level 10 DIVINE Divine-Beast boss (? ATK / ? DEF): gains 1000 ATK and DEF for each card in your hand; mandatory trigger whenever a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your opponent's field in Attack Position to reduce its ATK by 2000—and if its ATK hits 0 as a result, immediately destroys it!
The Revived Sky God

Core Normal Trap: its activation and effects CANNOT be negated; Special Summons 1 'Slifer the Sky Dragon' from your GY, then makes each player draw until they have 6 cards in their hand (instantly giving Slifer 6000 ATK/DEF on your opponent's turn!); and banishes itself from your GY to stack or add 'Monster Reborn' from your Deck or GY!
Thunderforce Attack

Signature Quick-Play Spell: its activation and effect CANNOT be negated; while you control a 'Slifer the Sky Dragon' whose original name is Slifer, destroys as many face-up monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if activated during your Main Phase, you draw 1 card for EACH monster destroyed by this effect (giving Slifer +1000 ATK per draw AND letting Slifer attack directly!)!
Soul Crossing
Quick-Play Spell: during the Main Phase, immediately Tribute Summons Slifer the Sky Dragon from your hand by Tributing up to 3 monsters from your opponent's field!
Reactor Slime
Special Summons 2 Slime Tokens during your Main Phase for a 3-Tribute Summon of Slifer, or tributes itself to Set Metal Reflect Slime / summon Egyptian God Slime.
Guardian Slime
Special Summons itself when you take battle or effect damage and tributes itself for Egyptian God Slime (which counts as 3 Tributes for Slifer!).
Joker's Straight

Discards 1 card (putting Slifer into the GY for The Revived Sky God!) to assemble Queen's Knight, King's Knight, and Jack's Knight on the field from 1 Spell, and recycles itself from the GY during the End Phase to boost Slifer's ATK by +1000!
Joker's Knight
Special Summons itself from hand by sending a Poker Knight from Deck to GY, and recycles itself from your GY to your hand during every End Phase (+1000 ATK for Slifer!).
Imperial Bower
Tributes itself to search or Special Summon 2 of Queen's, King's, and Jack's Knight.
King's Knight
Special Summons Jack's Knight from your Deck when Normal Summoned via Joker's Straight.
Queen's Knight
Summoned from your Deck by Joker's Straight.
Jack's Knight
Summoned from your Deck by King's Knight to complete 3 Tributes for Slifer the Sky Dragon.
Trap Trick
Banishes 1 'The Revived Sky God' from your Deck to Set a second copy directly to your field that can be activated the same turn!
Monster Reborn
Limited to 1 in TCG: searched/stacked from your Deck or GY by The Revived Sky God's GY effect to revive Slifer a second time!
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Slifer the Sky Dragon directly from your Deck to the GY on Turn 1 to turn on The Revived Sky God and Trap Trick!
extra: Level 10 WATER Aqua Fusion boss (3000 ATK / 3000 DEF): Special Summoned by Tributing Guardian Slime; cannot be destroyed by battle, protects Slifer from being targeted by opponent's card effects, and counts as 1 or 3 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of Slifer the Sky Dragon!
